dog.description_text:
Meet Lady: Professional Ball Chaser, Bird Watcher & Full-Time Sweetheart 🐾

Lady is a sweet, playful, and incredibly smart 11-month-old girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart! She's equal parts adventurous athlete and professional couch potato. One minute she's sprinting after a tennis ball, and the next she's curled up next to you for a well-deserved nap.

Don't let her athletic abilities fool you - Lady is a total sweetheart who loves being close to her people. Whether you're watching a movie on the couch or lounging in the sun, she's loves to cuddle and nap next to you.

Lady is incredibly smart and eager to learn. She picked up potty training in just THREE days! She's also a huge fan of toys, especially anything that lights up, squeaks, or can be used for a good game of tug-of-war. Fetch might just be her favorite sport, and she's convinced she could go pro.

On walks, Lady is a dedicated sniffer and an enthusiastic bird watcher. She's curious about the world around her and loves exploring new places. She's interested in other dogs, though she can sometimes get a little too excited and is still working on staying calm during introductions.

Lady's Resume

- Personality & Characteristics: Playful, Cuddly, energetic

- Potty trained: ✅ Learned in just 3 days!

- Crate trained: ✅ Her crate is her happy place and sleeps through the night and doesn't even bark in the morning! and she knows the BED command.

- Energy Level: 8/10 Outside, 2/10 Inside

- Leash training ✅: She get curious on walks and will try to tug but we gave her a front harness which has completely changed the game.

- Basic commands: She knows sit, paw, other paw, down, bed, stay

- Favorite activities: Fetch, tug-of-war, sniffing, bird chasing, and sunbathing

- Favorite toys: Anything that squeaks, lights up, or can be chased

- Appetite: 10/10! She eats twice a day and loves her food so much. Very treat motivated!

- Potty habit: Poops first thing in the morning (grass or concrete), pees every time she goes outside (on grass)

- Sleeping habits: Professional napper. Loves a sunny spot during the day and curling up next to her humans

- My foster dog is good with: Previous foster before me had cats and a 3 year old so she would be great with a family

- Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: In between (barks when hears noise outside sometimes or if a dog starts barking at her first)

Why You'll Fall in Love With Lady

Lady is the kind of dog who makes every day a little more entertaining. She's goofy, curious, athletic, and so incredibly sweet. Watching her experience new things is pure joy, whether it's discovering a new squeaky toy (or chicken jerky), chasing a ball across the yard, or finding the perfect sunny spot for her afternoon nap.

She's already learned so much in such a short time, and with the right family, we know she'll continue to blossom.

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs.

Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
